dimension_definitions.biological_activity: (z_MBC+z_RESP)/2; activity construct, raw response directions retained

M3: standardized x/y linear and quadratic spatial terms

methods.piecewise_sem: standardized regression equations, 5 km block-cluster covariance when supported
methods.CB_SEM_custom_observed_path: custom observed-variable covariance path approximation on sample-standardized scale; iid descriptive indices; not a mature package or spatially robust
methods.CB_SEM_lavaan_ML: mature lavaan observed-variable covariance-based path models for S1-S3 on representative D1-D4 populations and M0-M3 controls; standard iid maximum-likelihood fit indices; not spatially robust
methods.PLS_PM_ModeB_formative: local Mode-B formative weight iteration across S1-S3 and M0-M3 in D1-D4; controls are fixed single-indicator constructs; common rows within each population; no bootstrap intervals or spatially robust inference

spatial_summary.local_coefficient_quantiles: min, P5, P25, median, P75, P95, max and unit-level negative fraction from saved Phase I coefficients
spatial_summary.strong_negative_overlap: within each common support, compare lowest 10% local-beta units across SHI, OM and SW; descriptive Jaccard and Spearman statistics
spatial_summary.environment_context: join saved local coefficients to 240 m unit environment; continuous variables grouped by whole-domain rank quartiles; descriptive only
spatial_summary.model_comparison: saved GWR, GWR-LCR and MGWR local coefficients; no spatial model refit

populations.D1_full_pixels: CEC与健康完整案例；完整案例定义，不按健康效应筛选
populations.D1_common_env_case: 主要环境变量共同完整案例；用于M0–M3同样本比较
populations.D2_240m_blocks: 复现既有Phase I8的8×8环境完整单元支持（历史单元以SHI候选值参与汇总）
populations.D3_M4_unique_pixels: Phase H沿用Phase F/G历史M4/Aa_20yr端点成员（环境卡尺0.35、地理上限1,000m、组内侵蚀百分位差至少0.50）；按cell_id回连当前健康与CEC值
populations.D4_M4_pair_differences: Phase H第二阶段候选stage2_Aa_20yr_01（环境卡尺0.75、地理上限500m、土类内8组、组内侵蚀百分位差至少0.30）；按cell_id重算端点差。与D3为不同匹配版本
populations.D5_positive_erosion: D1共同环境完整案例中Aa_20yr大于0
populations.D6_zero_positive_pairs: D4中低侵蚀端为0且高侵蚀端大于0的既定配对
populations.D7_soil_TWI_groups: 主土类26/27/42内按各土类TWI秩划分四分位；未按SEM斜率挑选分组

outcome_guided_selection_objective: summarize F–I evidence and explore conditional path structure, health dimensions, and environment heterogeneity
